2609.02496.title: Debias-SparseGPT: Bias-Aware Pruning for Large Language Models
2609.02496.paper_summary: Model compression techniques such as pruning and quantization facilitate the efficient deployment and acceleration of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, recent studies show that weight sparsification methods, such as SparseGPT, can amplify existing biases in models, with outputs varying significantly depending on persona cues in the prompt. In this paper, we introduce Debias-SparseGPT, a post-training pruning method incorporating representational debiasing using a second-order term defined over demographically contrasting inputs. We perform empirical validation of our method over a wide range of generative LLMs. Across models and sparsity regimes (25%, 50%, and structured 2:4 sparsity), Debias-SparseGPT consistently reduces pruning-induced bias compared to SparseGPT while preserving model perplexity and zero-shot accuracy. Under the most restrictive 2:4 structured sparsity pattern, which most aggressively degrades model quality, augmenting the calibration set with long-context, content-rich examples further improves both downstream performance and fairness. Overall, Debias-SparseGPT advances the bias-performance trade-off while preserving the computational efficiency of sparse models.
2609.02496.paper_summary_zh: 模型壓縮技術如剪枝和量化促進了大型語言模型（LLMs）的高效部署和加速。<lb/>然而，最近的研究顯示，像SparseGPT這樣的權重稀疏化方法可能會放大模型中現有的偏見，輸出結果根據提示中的角色提示顯著變化。<lb/>在本文中，我們介紹了Debias-SparseGPT，一種後訓練剪枝方法，結合了使用定義在人口統計對比輸入上的二階項的表徵去偏見。<lb/>我們對我們的方法在各種生成性LLMs上進行了實證驗證。<lb/>在模型和稀疏性範疇（25%、50%和結構化2:4稀疏性）中，Debias-SparseGPT相比SparseGPT始終減少了剪枝引起的偏見，同時保持了模型的困惑度和零樣本準確性。<lb/>在最具限制性的2:4結構化稀疏模式下，這種模式最積極地降低模型質量，通過用長上下文、內容豐富的範例增強校準集進一步改善了下游性能和公平性。<lb/>總體而言，Debias-SparseGPT在保持稀疏模型計算效率的同時，推進了偏見與性能的權衡。
